analysis.severityReason: The issue blocks an important user flow.
analysis.priorityReason: The issue should be addressed quickly.

testCases.title: Valid login completes successfully
testCases.given: A registered user is on the login screen
testCases.then: The user should reach the dashboard

testCases.title: Invalid login shows an error
testCases.then: The app should show a clear error message

testCases.title: Repeated login taps remain stable
testCases.given: A valid user taps the login button multiple times
testCases.when: Authentication requests finish out of order
testCases.then: The screen should not remain stuck loading

analysis.possibleRootCause: The loading state may not be reset after the asynchronous authentication call completes.
